meta.title: LLM judge deployment boundary — proposed outbound connection

boundaries.label: Current local control-plane boundary — no new orchestrator

cards.title: A new model-service connection, not a hosting migration
items: API, PostgreSQL, private evidence and the Python worker retain their current local roles. No Temporal server, broker or Conductor connection is added.
Provider choice is pending. A hosted endpoint introduces an outbound data/credential boundary; a local endpoint uses a separately selected local runtime. Neither is provisioned or enabled.

cards.title: What can leave the worker
items: Only the scoped frozen rubric, mission requirements and approved bounded normalized evidence packet. No runner/API credentials, local filesystem paths, unrelated artifacts or unrestricted raw logs.

Configure timeout, token/cost limits, retention and secret injection before activation. Do not assume provider idempotency, zero retention or deterministic verdicts. Persist the actual accepted response.

cards.title: Scope and evidence status
items: This is a conceptual proposed deployment boundary for the uncommitted P17 design. It is not a claim of a hosted deployment or existing model integration.

P17.5 provider/config conventions can be reused after the applicable merge gate, with a separate judge configuration. LLM judging and criteria generation remain different prompts and responsibilities.
